sentences.text: Golshanichthys is an extinct genus of dunkleosteid fish found in Kerman, Iran. This animal is closely related to the giant Dunkleosteus.
The genus Golshanichthys was described by Lelièvre and colleagues in 1981.
Golshanichthys belongs to the family Dunkleosteidae. However, a 2016 study suggests the classification of Dunkleosteidae as a distinct clade separate from Dunkleosteoidea is uncertain.
This creature lived during the Frasnian stage of the Late Devonian period, between 382.31 and 379 million years ago.
